about: The falsifier: a capsule that answered nothing, taken in silence. Until epoch 202 topos-github's regions blob held dist/pipeline.js while its alias named dist/index.js, so its process never started. Each region it was asked came back empty, nothing was said, and the region counted as answered, so no other capsule was asked: verify's three pipelines and its .gitignore, topos-notation's four, and the tag and release pipelines of five topos places were written as pages of one byte.
Each of those twenty-eight requests was run again at every render, since nothing was kept.
